text.text_excerpt: I used to come to this place years and years ago when it was a dive bar that played Soulja Boy every single time you set foot in that place. I swear, that dude was that place's mascot. Anyway, Evangeline II is A LOT better than that. Evangeline has a nice cozy feel to it, and although it's small, it still has an area for a band to perform. The night we came there was a pretty cool cover band on stage. They have a really good beer selection and I was happy that there was a lot of seating at the bar. The bartender seemed really friendly and laid back and was really good about being prompt with our order. I definitely like this place as a laid back place to catch a band on the Avenue. It has...

Evangeline is a pretty cool bar with live music. It wasn't that long ago that I realized that I had been to nearly every bar in Uptown New Orleans. While trying to figure out a new place to go, I stumbled upon this place. I never thought about any bars other than Avenue Pub when I was in this area, so when I discovered Evangeline, I knew I had to check it out. the bar is long and narrow with the bar on one side, video poker on the other and a stage at the end of the building. The night I visited a patron told me about a $2 beer special so that is the direction I went. There is something very cool about listening to a band and drinking $2 Abita. Awesome bar!!! It use to be Whiskey Dix, which was a dive bar. They scrub the place clean, kicked out the bums and now it's an upscale bar off the Avenue!!! Great bartenders, good peeps and a awesome place to watch a game. It's sister bar is Evangeline in Mid-City!
